reason: A bridge that connects WeCom private-chat bots to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, relaying messages, agent responses, and multi-turn session history.

summaries.zh: 将企业微信智能机器人私聊消息接入本地 DeepSeek Harness agent，并把生成的回复发送回企业微信。
summaries.en: Connects WeCom intelligent bot private chats to a local DeepSeek Harness agent and sends generated responses back through WeCom.

capabilities: Connects to the WeCom intelligent bot long-connection API
Receives private chat messages from WeCom users
Sends received messages to a local DSH agent for responses and tool calls
Stores multi-turn session history in SQLite
Uses configured WeCom bot credentials and DSH model credentials
